comment: Extended two comma-joined statute chains (#4, #8). Added one BGE list item. OUTCOME FLAG: item 1 of the dispositiv dismisses only the suspension request (Sistierungsgesuch, 'abgewiesen'); item 2 declares the appeal inadmissible ('nicht eingetreten'). Per the item-1 rule the outcome is 'dismissed'; if the rule should skip procedural side requests, the outcome is 'inadmissible'. | caller: item 1 only rejects the Sistierungsgesuch; item 2 decides the appeal (nicht eingetreten).
